'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Spillover of the Syrian civil war]]
***A rocket attack on the Turkish [[Syria–Turkey border|border town]] of [[Karkamış]], kills three people, including a child. Interior Minister [[Süleyman Soylu]] blames [[Kurds|Kurdish]] militants in [[Syria]] and vows a "strong response". Kurdish groups have denied being behind the attack. [https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-several-killed-after-rockets-fired-from-syria/a-63829077 (DW)]
***A [[Turkish Land Forces|Turkish soldier]] is killed and seven police officers are injured after the [[Bab al-Hawa Border Crossing]] is [[Shell (projectile)|shelled]] by suspected Kurdish militants. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/suspected-kurdish-militants-fire-turkish-border-town-93705349 (ABC News)]
***[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] threatens to launch a ground operation in [[Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria|northern Syria]] and [[Iraqi Kurdistan]] in response to the rocket attacks on Turkish territory. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20221121-erdogan-threatens-ground-operation-in-syria-after-deadly-rocket-strike (France 24)]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**Two people are killed in a bombing in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blast-afghan-capital-kills-two-2022-11-21/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and 22 others are injured after an ambush on a major highway in [[Central Equatoria]], [[South Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-south-sudan-juba-uganda-6c71beaa51a4b17c764d0bed98ba9089 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 West Java earthquake]]
**A 5.6-magnitude [[list of earthquakes in Indonesia|earthquake]] kills at least 310 people and injures over 2,000 others in [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2022/1125/1338237-indonesia-death-toll/ (RTÉ)]
*[[2022 Anyang factory fire]]
**At least 38 people are killed and two others are injured by a fire at a factory in [[Anyang]], [[Henan]], [[China]]. Local officials report evidence of [[electric resistance welding]] violating [[workplace safety standards]] as the likely cause of the fire. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/china-factory-fire-that-killed-38-caused-by-illegal-welding-report-3542720 (AFP via NDTV)]
*A Piper PA-31 crashes into a residential area in the Belén Rosales, [[Medellín]], [[Colombia]], killing the eight people on board. [https://www.eltiempo.com/colombia/medellin/medellin-accidente-de-avioneta-contra-casa-los-8-ocupantes-murieron-719331 (El Tiempo)]
*One person is killed and 16 others are injured when a vehicle crashes into an [[Apple Store]] in [[Hingham, Massachusetts]], [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-63705867 (BBC News)]
*Twelve people are injured in an [[explosion]] at a school in [[Sydney]], [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.1news.co.nz/2022/11/21/multiple-sydney-students-injured-in-science-experiment-explosion/ (OneNews)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Mali relations]], [[Mali War]]
**The [[Assimi Goïta]]-led [[military junta]] prohibits the operation of [[France]]-supported [[Non-governmental organization|NGO]]s in [[Mali]] to [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocate]] the [[Government of France|French government]]'s suspension of [[development aid]] for the [[West Africa]]n country due to its involvement with [[Russia]]'s [[Wagner Group]] in the war. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/11/22/Mali-bans-French-backed-NGOs-activities-Govt (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Tel Aviv]] rules that former [[Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Ehud Olmert]] committed [[defamation]] against the family of prime minister-designate [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] by claiming that members of Netanyahu's family are [[mentally ill]] and orders Olmert to pay [[United States dollar|$]]18,000. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63703231 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Artemis program]]
**[[Artemis 1]]
***[[NASA]]'s [[Orion (spacecraft)|''Orion'' spacecraft]] performs a flyby of the [[Moon]], coming within {{conv|130|km|mi}} of the [[geology of the Moon|lunar surface]] before entering into a [[lunar orbit]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-63697714 (BBC News)]
